about_the_game:
The Gaming Cafe is a management simulation where you start from scratch and grow into a profitable, popular Gaming Cafe. Rent a place, plan the layout, attract customers with gaming stations, and expand your income through drink fridges and product shelves. Make smart investments, optimize operations, and scale your business step by step.

The core loop is simple: start small → upgrade smart → optimize the operation → expand to bigger goals. Your layout, capacity decisions, and upgrade choices directly affect customer satisfaction and daily revenue.

Key Features

  • Gaming Cafe Management: Rent a venue, set up your layout, place gaming stations, and run day-to-day operations.

  • Multiple Income Streams: Increase earnings not only from gaming customers but also through drink sales and shelf products.

  • Upgrade Choices: Pick boosts like more customers, higher profit margins, and faster progression.

  • Optimization-Focused Gameplay: Improve efficiency by refining layout, capacity, and peak-hour performance.

  • Strong Sense of Growth: Start with a small shop and evolve into a bigger, better business.

Gameplay Flow

  • Rent your first place and set up the basics.

  • Bring in customers with gaming stations and start earning.

  • Strengthen your flow and profits with upgrades.

  • Add a drink fridge and product shelves to diversify sales.

  • Optimize your layout to sell more and earn more.

Mature Content Warning:

This game contains content intended for mature audiences and may include scenes that some players could find sensitive. The game includes violence, gambling, alcohol consumption, sexual content, and other adult themes. Players may encounter the following content:

	•	Gambling: The game features various gambling options, where players can win or lose money through activities like roulette tables or slot machines.
	•	Alcohol and Entertainment Venues: Players can visit strip clubs, consume alcohol, and optionally request private dances.
	•	Violence and Crime: The game may contain elements of violence and crime, in which the player can participate or witness.
	•	Adult Themes: The game may include sexual content, but it does not feature disturbing themes such as forced sexual acts. These contents are only presented at the player’s discretion.

Please be aware of these elements and note that this content is only suitable for adult audiences.
